name: Max Spaceman
source:
Specialty: Captain/Scavenger
Location: Luna Station
Race: Human

Reserved, skeptical and harsh critic. He always likes to thoroughly think things through before taking action. If push comes to shove, he falls back on his instinct and his zero tolerance towards anything threatening him and his loved ones. His favorite weapon is his sardonic smile and sharp sarcasm.

Max was among the first children to be born on the Luna Station. The product of a middle class family in a meritocracy, he learnt very little that equality was never for the poor, but for the rich or sneaky. Life on the base meant that he either learned to survive and adapt in a world of the forever favored or be caught up in the tide of the ever growing and perpetually disappointed middle.

When his parents decided he should enlist in a technical school and follow in their footsteps, he understood that the time had come for him to leave and make his own way in the world.

Lacking any special talents, he relied on his ability to navigate social interactions and adapt to whatever constituted the most profitable outcome. His end goal ? Security through wealth.
